why: Severs the stylesheet from the resolved policy while leaving `transitionMs()` intact, so a player who asks for reduced motion gets their TRANSITIONS calmed and every keyframe ANIMATION still running -- the damage vignette, the life-loss pulse, the splash pulse, the countdown pop. Exactly the split the shipped code had before issue #631, except the OS query no longer papers over it. Invisible to any test that reads hud.css text, because the stylesheet is correct under this mutation; only an assertion on the ROOT ELEMENT after `setReducedMotion(true)` can see it.
